episode_title: EP. 139_The Castle That Costs Less Than a Scottsdale House with Mike Stohler

real_qa.q: How many rental units did Mike Stohler accumulate in his US real estate portfolio before selling to Iowa investors?
real_qa.r: Mike built up a portfolio of multifamily properties and eventually accumulated approximately 1,500 doors (rental units) before selling his portfolio to a group from Iowa at an IHOP breakfast meeting.

real_qa.q: What is the key lesson Mike Stohler teaches about starting a real estate business without proper knowledge?
real_qa.r: The biggest lesson is that buying is easy, but you must have the knowledge or a mentor to guide you. Mike warns against jumping into real estate after watching HGTV episodes or YouTube videos expecting to become a millionaire in 30 days—his early failures came from lack of knowledge, not from real estate itself.
real_qa.requete: buying real estate easy knowledge mentor

real_qa.q: Why did Mike Stohler pivot from multifamily real estate investing in the United States to projects in Spain?
real_qa.r: After selling his US multifamily portfolio, Mike moved capital into 1031 exchanges and began exploring international opportunities. He recognized the value in lifestyle flexibility and geographic diversification, spending significant time in Spain and developing real estate projects there through Gateway Private Equity Group.
real_qa.requete: Mike Stohler Spain real estate Gateway Private Equity

real_qa.q: What is Mike Stohler's core motivation for building an entrepreneurial empire, as expressed by his personal mission statement?
real_qa.r: Mike wrote on a sheet of printer paper with a black marker 18 years ago: 'Build a life I don't need a vacation from.' He still has this note on his desk and looks at it every day. This statement reflects his belief that entrepreneurship is not fundamentally about becoming rich, but about creating a lifestyle of autonomy and purpose.
real_qa.requete: build life don't need vacation from Mike Stohler

real_qa.q: How many episodes did Mike Stohler produce during his podcast career before shutting it down?
real_qa.r: Mike ran his podcast for approximately 7 or 8 years and produced 300 episodes before deciding to shut it down due to spending too much time in Spain and focusing on other ventures.
real_qa.requete: Mike Stohler podcast 300 episodes shut down

guest.titre_secondaire: Retired Navy Pilot turned Real Estate Investor
guest.bio_context: Mike Stohler is a retired Navy pilot who transitioned into real estate investing. He started with failed attempts at property investment in pre-internet Indiana, later became an airline pilot, and then returned to real estate with proper knowledge and mentorship, eventually building a portfolio of approximately 1,500 rental units before pivoting internationally to Spain-based development projects through Gateway Private Equity Group.

real_quote: Build a life I don't need a vacation from. And it is still there, it's all curled up, but I look at it every day and say, This is my why.
